changes_made.explanation: Added missing NLG tasks (mathematical reasoning and image generation) and their corresponding outputs. Removed redundant model specification (Qwen2.5-7B) since Qwen2.5 covers all variants. Normalized model names to standard forms.
Normalized all ROUGE variants to base ROUGE metric according to guidelines. Kept pass@1 as a distinct metric since it's fundamentally different from ROUGE.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper focuses on parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods, not LLM-based evaluation.
No human evaluation was mentioned in the paper. All evaluations were conducted using automatic metrics.

overall_notes: This paper primarily focuses on parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods (OFTv2 and QOFT) rather than NLG evaluation methodology. While it evaluates NLG tasks (summarization, mathematical reasoning, image generation), the main contribution is the fine-tuning technique itself. The evaluation uses standard automatic metrics but does not introduce new evaluation methodologies. The extraction was generally accurate but missed some NLG tasks that were evaluated.
